Messages.Author: Hollowboy
Messages.Body:
Hi rulesmongers,

I know there is a lot of stuff Beast can't do. He can't equip, he cant
have it transferred to him, he is immune to Charnas the Imp.

With Charnas, I'm presuming that the action is simply prohibited. That
is, in a tournament, if Muaziz attempted to put Charnas on Beast, out
of options

a) Action declared illegal - Muaziz untaps, Tremere player puts
Charnas back in hand
b) Action successful, but Charnas immediately burns

...I presume a) is the one to use.

How about if Beast diablerises Black Cat, and Black Cat has oodles of
equipment.

a) Action declared illegal, Beast untaps
b) Diablerie succeeds, and all the equipment is burned rather than
transferred to Beast

And, if Tariq rushes Beast, plays some funky stuff, then slaps with
the Rowan Ring

a) Strike declared illegal
b) Strike OK, but ring is burned, and has no effect
c) Strike OK, ring is burned, but it's text triggers first (sending
Beast to torpor)

Thanks for looking,

Craig

Messages.Body:

my guess :

> How about if Beast diablerises Black Cat, and Black Cat has oodles of
> equipment.
>
> a) Action declared illegal, Beast untaps
> b) Diablerie succeeds, and all the equipment is burned rather than
> transferred to Beast

B, of course, the "move equipment" part being only an effect following the
diablerie itself =)

> And, if Tariq rushes Beast, plays some funky stuff, then slaps with
> the Rowan Ring
>
> a) Strike declared illegal
> b) Strike OK, but ring is burned, and has no effect
> c) Strike OK, ring is burned, but it's text triggers first (sending
> Beast to torpor)

C. Card text "send the opposing vampire in torpor" applies. But when "this
card is transfered to the opposing vampire", it burns.
